Plan: Student Day Tracker v1

2026-09-26 · toàn bộ requirement/Requirement.docx · agent: planner → next: implementer · Frontend trước (mock data), Backend sau (Dexie thật) · xem mục Q&A trước khi implement Backend

1. Frontend

1.1 Scope

Build the UI for all three screens + the Add Activity form, running on mock/local data. Backend (§2) wires the real persistence in afterward — Frontend should not touch Dexie writes.

Trong scope:

  • Home (src/app/page.tsx), History (src/app/history/page.tsx), Insights (src/app/insights/page.tsx)
  • Add Activity form (req. 1.3), including the inline "+ New category" row
  • All UI matches the mockups reconstructed in 1.2 below
  • Home/History keep their existing real Dexie read wiring as-is — useActivities / useCategories
  • Insights' 5 subsections, and the in-session effect of submitting the Add Activity form, run on realistic static mock data — same numbers as the mockups, kept clearly separate so Backend can swap in live queries without touching layout

Ngoài scope (explicit):

  • No db.activities.add/update/delete or db.categories.add calls — Add/Edit/Delete Activity and new-category only change local component state for the current session (resets on reload)
  • No real weekly/monthly aggregation, comparison, or insight-card logic — Insights renders from a static fixture
  • Note: this is a deliberate, temporary exception to this repo's rule "a disabled placeholder only loses disabled once the feature works end-to-end" (CLAUDE.md) — Backend phase is what makes it true end-to-end

1.2 Structure of UI

Mockups below are reconstructed from requirement/Requirement.docx (not copied 1:1) as self-contained HTML/CSS/SVG, styled with this app's real category colors. After the mockups, a table maps each requirement section to the real/planned component.

Sitemap / cấu trúc tổng thể

Toàn app chỉ có 3 trang điều hướng (Home / History / Insights) và 1 hành động nổi (+ Add Activity) — không có trang "nhập liệu" riêng. Nguyên tắc thiết kế là hỏi ít nhất có thể: chỉ "Bạn làm gì?" và "Từ mấy giờ đến mấy giờ?", còn category / thời lượng / tổng ngày / xu hướng tuần / insight (pipeline phía dưới diagram) đều được suy ra tự động từ hai câu trả lời đó.

2. Backend

2.1 Scope

Wire real Dexie persistence behind the UI Frontend already built. No new Dexie schema version is expected — everything reuses the stores/indexes already declared in db.ts.

Trong scope:

  • db.activities.add/update/delete for Add/Edit/Delete Activity
  • db.categories.add for custom categories
  • Each write behind a pure, synchronously-throwing builder in src/lib/, following the established pattern (get-daily-summary.ts, build-month-grid.ts): plain functions over arrays/primitives, tested without Dexie, wired into the UI only via useLiveQuery
  • The aggregation logic Insights needs — weekly/monthly rollups, a "compare to previous period" delta, an insight-card rule engine, per-activity analytics — as pure helpers over Activity[] + Category[], replacing the Frontend-phase mock fixture
  • Date-range reads for Insights reuse the existing date index on activities (.where('date').between(...))

Ngoài scope (explicit):

  • Auth, multi-device sync — never in scope for this app (ADR-001)
  • Deleting/editing a custom category after creation (see Q&A)

2.2 Feature

Add Activity — validates and writes an Activity, live query re-renders ActivityTimeline + DailySummaryCard.

flowchart LR
  A["AddActivityForm.onSubmit"] --> B["buildActivity(): validate, trim, id/createdAt"]
  B -->|throws on invalid input| A
  B --> C["db.activities.add()"]
  C --> D["useActivities live query"]
  D --> E["ActivityTimeline"]
  D --> F["DailySummaryCard via getDailySummary()"]

Edit / Delete Activity — same live query re-renders both consuming components regardless of which path is taken.

flowchart LR
  A["ActivityTimeline: Edit or Delete click"] --> B{"Edit or Delete?"}
  B -->|Edit| C["AddActivityForm prefilled -> buildUpdatedActivity()"]
  B -->|Delete| D["ConfirmDialog confirm -> db.activities.delete()"]
  C --> E["db.activities.update()"]
  E --> F["useActivities live query"]
  D --> F
  F --> G["ActivityTimeline + DailySummaryCard re-render"]

Add custom Category — deduped case-insensitively; the new category is immediately selectable and colors/icons everywhere that looks it up by id.

flowchart LR
  A["'+ New category' row in AddActivityForm"] --> B["buildCategory(): trim + dedupe case-insensitive"]
  B -->|throws on empty/duplicate name| A
  B --> C["db.categories.add()"]
  C --> D["useCategories live query"]
  D --> E["Category select in AddActivityForm"]
  D --> F["DailySummaryCard + ActivityTimeline icon/color lookup"]

Weekly / Monthly Insights aggregation — the core deliverable. Built the same way as getDailySummary: pure helpers over arrays, composed via useMemo in the Insights page (no new global state, per ADR-004).

flowchart TD
  A["useActivitiesRange(startIso, endIso) + useCategories"] --> B["getWeeklySummary() / getMonthlySummary()"]
  B --> C["WeeklyOverviewChart / MonthlyOverviewCard"]
  B --> D["comparePeriods(current, previous)"]
  D --> E["ComparePanel"]
  B --> F["buildInsightCards(): rule engine"]
  F --> G["InsightCards"]

Activity Analytics — drill-down triggered by clicking an activity's name.

flowchart LR
  A["ActivityAnalyticsPanel: click an activity"] --> B["useActivitiesRange(all-time or selected range)"]
  B --> C["getActivityAnalytics(activityName)"]
  C --> D["sessions / avg / longest / most common time"]
  D --> E["ActivityAnalyticsPanel re-renders with real stats"]

Q&A

Genuine gaps in requirement/Requirement.docx / docs/REQUIREMENTS.md that materially change Backend scope — flagging before build-insight-cards.ts and the week/month boundary logic get built, since retrofitting them later touches tested pure helpers.

  • Insight card rules: the mockup shows 4 specific narratives ("Your Routine", "Your Week", "Your Pattern", "Consistency") but req. 3.3 only says "short, specific observations automatically derived from data" — no thresholds, tie-break rules, or minimum data requirements are specified. Affects the shape and test cases of buildInsightCards().
  • Insufficient history: what should Compare (3.2) and the insight cards show on day one, before a full previous week/month of data exists? Not addressed anywhere. Affects whether comparePeriods()/buildInsightCards() need an explicit "not enough data yet" return case, and whether the UI needs a matching empty state distinct from EmptyState.
  • Week/month boundary + timezone: Activity.date is a local YYYY-MM-DD string, but it's unclear whether "this week" for Insights means a calendar week starting Monday (matching History's buildMonthGrid Mon–Sun grid) or a rolling 7-day window. Affects getWeeklySummary()'s date-bucketing and what "last week" means for comparePeriods().
  • Custom category lifecycle: req. 1.3 / Category.isDefault only say the 4 seeded categories can't be deleted — nothing addresses whether a user-created category can later be renamed or deleted (and, if deleted, what happens to its existing activities). Affects whether Backend needs deleteCategory()/ updateCategory() at all for v1.
  • Overlapping time ranges: getDailySummary's own docstring says overlap is "the caller's concern" — the requirement doc never says whether two activities may overlap on the same day, or whether buildActivity()/ buildUpdatedActivity() should reject overlap. Affects validation strictness in both builders.
  • "Other" category: one of the extracted mockup captions (simplified daily summary variant) lists "Work / Study / Exercise / Other" rather than the seeded Work/Study/Exercise/Entertainment. Likely just an inconsistency in the original docx image, but worth an explicit confirm before anyone reads "Other" as a requirement — doesn't block Backend build either way, since defaults are already fixed in default-categories.ts.

Success criteria

  • Home, History, Insights all render the mockups reconstructed in 1.2 (structure + data shape), no more dashed placeholder sections on Insights
  • + Add Activity, Edit, and Delete are no longer disabled; Frontend phase: changes are session-local; Backend phase: changes persist across reload via Dexie
  • Adding a custom category makes it immediately selectable and colors/icons it consistently in the form, timeline, and summary
  • Insights' 5 subsections read from real Activity/Category data after Backend phase (weekly/monthly totals, compare, insight cards, activity analytics), not the Frontend-phase fixture
  • Every new pure helper (buildActivity, buildUpdatedActivity, buildCategory, getWeeklySummary, getMonthlySummary, comparePeriods, buildInsightCards, getActivityAnalytics) has a co-located unit test, tested without Dexie
  • Open Q&A items are resolved (or explicitly deferred with a stated default) before buildInsightCards() and the week/month boundary logic are implemented
  • pnpm typecheck && pnpm check && pnpm test -- --run && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e all pass
  • 0 axe violations on all three routes, including with the Add Activity dialog open
  • The Frontend build is live on GitHub Pages at a public URL Customer can open directly to review the design, with all 3 routes working (not just the homepage)
